ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-tan potato-like chunks with golden-brown edges and small darker speckles, roughly wedge-shaped pieces about 3-4 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, dry matte surface with light browning and crisp-looking edges, clustered in the center-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark brown, crusty piece with a glossy caramelized surface and irregular edges, about 2.5 cm by 2 cm and roughly 1 cm thick, sitting at the right side of the plate separate from the main cluster | 15
ITEM 3 | Thin, dark brown browned slice partly tucked under the potato wedges, about 2.5 cm long and under 0.5 cm thick, with a slightly darker, seared appearance and no visible sauce | 8
ITEM 4 | Small bright orange-red fleck, about 0.5 cm across, lying on top of one potato piece near its upper edge, moist-looking with slight sheen | 1
